'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Joseph Graham LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
